scope.workload: existing 3M structured TET4 linear-static FEM model
scope.loads_and_boundary_conditions: WP14 fixed x=0 and uniform nodal x-load with total reference force 1e6 N

fixed_solver_configuration.graph_partition_comparison: optional only if separately executed and provenance-complete

mpi_v2.eight_rank_policy: If unavailable on the recorded host, classify PASS_WITH_LIMITATIONS and do not claim FULL MPI_V2.
mpi_v2.weak_scaling: SHOULD; not required for this closeout

phase_metrics.unmeasured_policy: null is retained; unmeasured phases are not inferred or used as independently measured claims

acceptance.preconditioner_selection: Compare total time, phase time, RSS, convergence, acceptance and replay stability; iterations alone are insufficient.

configuration_freeze.change_policy: No change after freeze except a documented blocker and Owner review.
configuration_freeze.selection_policy: Choose the best fully evidenced configuration using reproducible total-time/RSS/robustness evidence; do not optimize a single phase in isolation.

artifact_policy.text_digest: UTF-8 canonical JSON with sorted keys, compact separators and LF

limitations: The runner does not independently time preflight, redistribution, communication or I/O; those fields remain null in derived Observatory records.
The evidence is a single structured TET4 linear-static workload and a single Docker host profile.
GAMG/HYPRE comparison is empirical for the recorded workload and is not a universal preconditioner recommendation.
PETSc remains optional at runtime and unavailable selection must fail closed.
